newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi files for preferred security.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi files for preferred security.

text.p: A business trust formed by Mississippi Valley Bancshares Inc filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 520,000 floating rate cumulative trust preferred securities.
The trust, known as MVBI Capital Trust, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in subordinated debentures of Mississippi Valley Bancshares Inc.
The company said it intends to use the net proceeds from the sale of the debentures for general corporate purposes, including possible repurchase of outstanding shares of the company's common.
The underwriter have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 78,000 additional preferred securities. The offering will be made through Stifel, Nicolaus and Co Inc.
The preferred securities have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred security, the filing said.
The St. Louis, Mo.,-based company has applied to trade the preferred securities on Nasdaq under the stock symbol "MVBIP". Mississippi Valley is the parent company of Southwest Bank.
Mississippi Valley is a one-bank holding company engaged primarily in commercial lending through Southwest Bank of St. Louis.
